scope: Joint length distribution in 10,636 source-English-labeled records from the 20,000-record block sample.

definitions.length: Whitespace-delimited word count across all stored messages of each role in one record; not model tokens.
definitions.template: Both the pre-existing named_bot_persona and group_environment literal patterns match user text. This does not establish authentic group interaction.
definitions.panels: Disjoint partition: 704 known group-template records and 9,932 other English-labeled records.
definitions.axes: log10(1 + word count), with tick labels in original word counts; zero lengths remain included.
definitions.color: Number of records per hexagon, shared logarithmic color scale. Panels have unequal sample sizes; intensity is not a normalized share.
definitions.interpretation: Descriptive shapes only. Model, time, and task mix differ across panels. No causal or population claim.
